Annual standardized GPR and the annual change in log REER

Each chart is one country. The blue line is the average of monthly standardized GPR during the calendar year, measured on the left axis. The rust line is the sum of the monthly changes in log REER during that year, measured on the right axis. Both lines are on the same chart. The correlation next to the country name is the Pearson correlation of those two annual series.

Each year has all twelve months. 2000 is omitted because the January log-REER change is blank, so the charts run from 2001 through 2023. Source: cleaned/replication_cleaned/country_month.csv.
